notes: Real MFS field exports, January 2025 – 8 October 2026.
One row per Republic, RQII and region, for each month and for each year (month = All).
first_visit_pct = accident calls resolved on the first visit / visited calls.
leaks_per_km = leak points on inspections / km inspected.
pipe_coverage_pct = km inspected / km planned. reg_coverage_pct = completed regulator inspections / planned.
leak_repair_24h_pct = leak calls sent to repair within 24 h / leak calls sent to repair.
rc_24h_pct = meter opening orders completed within 24 h / completed opening orders. rc_completion_pct = completed / all opening orders.
dc_7d_pct = disconnection visits within 7 days / timed visits. dc_cut_pct = visits where gas was cut off / visits.
mr_24h_pct = meter replacement acts completed within 24 h / timed acts.
mr_tamper = replacements whose removed meter showed tamper or revenue-loss signs.
BRQİİ and BRQSD are combined as BRQİİ / BRQSD.
